units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 16:5">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XVI, 5</cite>.—Y. B. Bath. VIII, 16ᵇ bot. <he>צַרְכַת וזבנת וכ׳</he> she needed money and sold to her husband (the property which she had assigned to her brother).

Y. Erub. V, beg. 22ᵇ [read:] צ׳ לך צחק לך לא צ׳ לך הפליג עליך he who needs thee may smile (assent) to thee (flatter thee), he who needs thee not, dares to wonder at thee (in disapproval); Y. Snh. XI, 30ᵇ top צריך לך שחק וכ׳; a. e.—Mostly pass. צְרִיךְ to need, be needed.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 11:4:4">Ib.</cite> <he>תלת עשרה … דלא צ׳ ליה</he> he spent thirteen years … without needing him.
<cite ref="Taanit 20b:6">Taan. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>לא צְרִיכְנָא האידנא</he> now we do not need it.
<cite ref="Yevamot 105b:10">Yeb. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>תא לא צְרִיכַת</he> come back, she needs not (to be examined, or: thou needest not examine her).
<cite ref="Berakhot 13b:15">Ber. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>תו לא צריכת</he> more you need not do; a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 16:5">Targ. Y. I Gen. XVI, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 47:12">Ib. XLVII, 12</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Taanit 23a:18">Taan. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>כי מִצְטְרִיךְ עלמא למטרא</he> whenever the world needed rain.
Ber. 9ᵃ א׳ למכתב וכ׳ it was necessary (in the Scriptural text) to write hazzeh.
Ib. 13ᵃ והיו … למה לי א׳ וכ׳ that v’hayu (Deut. VI, 6) which is written, what is it for? It is needed because of the preceding sh’mʿa.
<cite ref="Beitzah 7a">Bets. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ לאשמעינן</he> it was necessary to let us understand distinctly.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 31a:5">Bekh. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>אִיצְטְרִיכָא ליה שעתא</he> the time needed him, i.e. the scholars felt in need of his teaching.

<cite ref="Chullin 38a:1">Ḥull. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>איצטריכא ליה לאבא לאזוזי וכ׳</he> does Abba (do you) consider the shaking of the ears (of the animal) an indispensable symptom of vitality? <cite ref="Ketubot 22a:7">Keth. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>אלא כי א׳ קרא לכדרב הונא וכ׳</he> but that citation is needed for the rule which R. H. … deduced from it.
<cite ref="Ketubot 97a:10-11">Ib. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>אִיצְטְרִיכוּ … למזבן וכ׳</he> he wanted money to buy oxen; <he>לסוף לא איצטריכו ליה</he> finally he found that he could do without it.
<cite ref="Berakhot 47b:16">Ber. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>תרי איצטריכו</he> two more persons were wanted (to make up the legal quorum); a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91">Gen. R. s. 91</cite> <he>אִיצְטַרְכִית למשאליה</he> I felt the need of asking him; Y. Ber. VII, 11ᵇ <he>אִצָּרְכַת לי</he> sub. <he>למשאליה</he>, v. <cite ref="R00774"><he>צְרִיךְ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Gittin 63b:4">Gitt. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>אַצְרְכָהּ</he> … <he>גט</he> R. … decided that she required a letter of divorce.
